title: 2 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 1
description: Ten questions on 2 Samuel 1: an Amalekite brings news of Saul's death, and David laments over Saul and Jonathan.

questions.text: How did the man who came from Saul's camp look when he arrived?
questions.explanation: On the third day a man came out of the camp from Saul, with his clothes torn and earth on his head.

answers.text: Wounded and carried on a stretcher
Clothes torn, with earth on his head

questions.text: According to the young man, what was Saul leaning on when he found him?
questions.explanation: The young man said that on Mount Gilboa, Saul was leaning on his spear, with chariots and horsemen close behind him.

questions.text: What did the young man tell Saul he was?
questions.explanation: When Saul asked, "Who are you?" he answered, "I am an Amalekite."

questions.text: What did the young man bring to David?
questions.explanation: He said, "I took the crown that was on his head and the bracelet that was on his arm, and have brought them here to my lord."

questions.text: Until when did David and his men mourn, weep, and fast?
questions.explanation: They mourned, wept, and fasted until evening for Saul, Jonathan, the people of Yahweh, and the house of Israel.

questions.text: What did David ask the young man after hearing his story?
questions.explanation: David said, "Why were you not afraid to stretch out your hand to destroy Yahweh's anointed?"

answers.text: Why he had not brought Jonathan's body
How many men had died in the battle
Why he was not afraid to destroy Yahweh's anointed
Whether he would serve in David's army

questions.text: What did David command one of his young men to do to the Amalekite?
questions.explanation: David called one of the young men and said, "Go near, and cut him down!" and he struck him so that he died.

questions.text: In which book is the song of the bow written?
questions.explanation: David commanded them to teach the children of Judah the song of the bow, which is written in the book of Jashar.

answers.text: The book of the kings of Judah
The book of Samuel the seer

questions.text: In which city did David say, "Don't tell it"?
questions.explanation: David's lament says, "Don't tell it in Gath," lest the daughters of the Philistines rejoice.

questions.text: According to the lament, Saul and Jonathan were swifter than what and stronger than what?
questions.explanation: The lament says they were swifter than eagles and stronger than lions.

answers.text: Swifter than horses, stronger than bears
Swifter than gazelles, stronger than oxen
Swifter than eagles, stronger than lions
Swifter than the wind, stronger than iron
